newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares knocked down by Creditanstalt.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares knocked down by Creditanstalt.

text.p: 1215 GMT - Austrian shares shed 0.8 percent in overall limp trade on Tuesday to end just off session lows.
Market weighed down by Creditanstalt after Finance Ministry reopens bidding for the state's majority stake in the bank.
* October ATX future down 8.5 points at 1,033.
* 19 ATX shares down, just two up.
* Leading decliner Wolford, down 5.24 percent at 2,550.
* Top gainer Boehler, up 1.45 percent at 837.
* Creditanstalt's preferred shares the most actively traded, falling 11.5 schillings to 447 on turnover of over 48,000 lots. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
